# OpenStrata

Sovereign strata corporation operations — strata governance, treasury, and property-management tools on Bitcoin rails. BCFSA-aware software built for British Columbia first, config-driven everywhere.

## Core pages

- [Home / Dashboard](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/) — community operations dashboard
- [About](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/about) — trusted money, proven operations
- [Pitch](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/pitch) — investor deck with live data
- [Strata Tool](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/tools) — 30+ management modules
- [Building Template Wizard](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/tools/wizard) — generate a portable building config JSON
- [Compliance Knowledge Base](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/compliance) — SPA + BCFSA compliance reference
- [Legal Library](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/legal) — primary BC legal sources
- [Templates](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/templates) — governance, finance, and conveyancing workflows
- [How your money is held](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/custody) — where community money sits at every step, and the limits OpenStrata cannot cross (0% custody)
- [Search](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/search?q=Form%20B) — the shareable search page: same index as the ⌘K modal, one link per query
- [Print-ready documents](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/documents) — meeting notice, minutes, Form B and Form F, laid out to print on real paper (template preview with sample data)
- [FAQ](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/faq) — plain-language BC strata answers
- [Roadmap](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/roadmap) — go-to-market paths, phases, and the UI polish queue
- [Units](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/units) — Evergreen House lot register (demo, 40 lots, 4 floors)
- [Accounting](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/accounting) — operating, contingency reserve, and the parkade levy
- [Pay](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/pay) — e-transfer, Bitcoin, and Lightning stay visible
- [Tax and CRA](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/tax) — sample returns, payroll, and the owner-tax desk
- [Calendar](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/calendar) — fees, council, inspections, and CRA dates
- [Meetings](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/meetings) — council, the AGM, and how a vote is counted
- [Docs](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/docs) — architecture and documentation hub
- [Blog](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/blog) — announcements and deep dives
- [Changelog](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/changelog) — every release, newest first, with verification notes
- [RSS & API](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/rss) — feeds and REST endpoints
- [OpenStrata Spec](https://openstrata.giveabit.io/spec) — sovereign data portability standard

## Evergreen House (demo only)

Sample building for a self-managed strata. Plan LMS 2847, 4100 Cambie Street, Vancouver, 4 floors, 40 lots, books as of 2026-09-30. Payment destinations on `/pay` are not payable. Tax copy is a sample, not a filing, and not tax advice. Do not replace the 6-lot seed in `src/lib/units.ts` with this 40-lot story. The 40-lot data lives in `src/lib/demo/`.

## For other models

The interface keeps being refined as the product grows. After every push that changes what a person sees, offer exactly four concrete UI upgrades and wait. The owner picks one or two. Polish only those. When a pick ships, replace it so four are always waiting. Do not start a queued item before it is picked.

Shipped 2026-10-16: the one-lot pay sheet on `/pay` (v0.3.30) — offered 2026-09-30, picked by the owner. One amount, three large choices, the rate lock as a quiet stamp, PAD and cheque tucked under the sheet. It was replaced, so four are waiting again.

Offered 2026-10-29, not started:

1. A payables sheet for the close — `/accounting`. The Payables tab is the last tab on the page with no paper: the bills by vendor and account, the CRA remittance due 15 October, what falls due inside the next 30 days and the total a council approves. Print it as one page — the same $6,500.00 of bills and $117.10 of source deductions the reconciliation now counts, with the days each one has left.
2. A trial balance on paper — `/accounting`. The Journal tab prints the cash statement and the screen table chains its hashes, but the month has no page that adds debits and credits by account and proves they agree. Give the tab a second sheet: every account that moved in September with its debits, its credits and its balance, the two columns totalling the same figure, and the accounts that did not move named rather than dropped.
3. A proxy card with the notice — `/meetings`. The packet prints the notice, the agenda, the last minutes and the quorum maths; the form an owner actually returns is still missing. Add a proxy page — the lot, the appointee, the meeting and its date, the direction if the bylaw requires one, and the signature line — with the same 7-day notice arithmetic the packet already does.
4. The fee schedule by lot — `/units`. The monthly fee is computed for every lot and shown one lot at a time; the building has no sheet that lists all 40 with their entitlement, their fee, the operating and reserve split and the annual total. Print it as the page a council approves with the budget, and let the register's tenanted lots be the first cut of it.

Shipped from that offer: the September close on `/accounting` (v0.3.40), the next-30-days strip on `/tax` and `/calendar` (v0.3.41), the release trail on `/changelog` (v0.3.43), the floor plan on `/units` with the statement on `/accounting` (v0.3.44), aged arrears on `/accounting` with a lot's own sheet at `/units/207` (v0.3.45), health over time on `/` (v0.3.46), the Form K register at `/units/register` (v0.3.48), the reserve fund's five-year picture on `/accounting` (v0.3.49), the year on one page with the AGM packet (v0.3.50), the receipt on `/pay` with a search that reaches lots, journal entries and tax sections (v0.3.51), the budget that prints with the year's deadlines on one page (v0.3.52), the AGM package in one print with filters that stay put and the budget's reasons beside the variance (v0.3.53), the arrears ladder on paper (v0.3.54), the cash statement with its chain (v0.3.55), the close reconciliation on `/accounting` (v0.3.56), and the levy statement, the budget in the reader's language and the Form K register in the package (v0.3.57). Requested outside the queue and shipped since: the month following the funds tab with a Form K recorded from the lot's sheet (v0.3.47).
